jobs.title: Data Analyst, New Grad
jobs.description:
Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the way you do job search from solo, time-consuming efforts to a fast, expert-guided journey, simplifying every job search step and accelerating your route to the best job outcomes. As a Data Analyst, New Grad, you will work onsite with product, engineering, and AI teams to turn product, job market, and user data into insights that directly influence product development.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Analyze product, user, and job market data to identify trends and opportunities
• Write SQL queries and build reports, dashboards, and analytical tools
• Define and monitor key product and business metrics
• Support A/B tests and evaluate new product features
• Investigate data quality issues and improve reporting accuracy
• Present findings to product, engineering, and business stakeholders
• Collaborate closely with the team in an onsite environment
Qualification

Required

• Recent graduate or graduating soon in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field
• Strong SQL skills and familiarity with spreadsheets or Python
• Understanding of basic statistics, data analysis, and experimentation
• Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work onsite in the SF Bay Area

Preferred

• Experience with pandas, scikit-learn, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools
• Familiarity with product analytics, recommendation systems, or search
• Experience working with large or messy datasets
• Previous internship, research, or analytics project experience

We pride ourselves in our commitment to doing what it takes for ALL students to reach their potential. We are seeking highly qualified teachers, classified staff and district leadership interested in being part of Fountain Valley School District, and preparing our students for success in the classroom and beyond. FVSD strives to recruit and retain the very best to join our family, seeking candidates committed to inspiring students to be critical thinkers, committed learners and caring citizens.

jobs.title: Data Analyst, AI Agent Analytics — New Grad
jobs.description:
Jobright is your personal AI job search agent that transforms the way you do job search from solo, time-consuming efforts to a fast, expert-guided journey, simplifying every job search step and accelerating your route to the best job outcomes. As a New Grad Data Analyst focused on AI Agent Analytics, you will measure agent quality, understand user interactions, and turn complex behavioral data into insights that improve our AI systems.

Why Join Us

• Build real, production AI agents used by real users
• High ownership and impact
• Work at the intersection of AI, agents, and product
• Shape how people experience AI-driven job search

Responsibilities

• Define metrics for agent task completion, quality, latency, reliability, and cost
• Analyze agent conversations, tool usage, errors, and user feedback
• Build SQL queries, dashboards, and recurring reports
• Identify failure patterns and improvement opportunities
• Support experiments involving prompts, models, tools, and workflows
• Present actionable recommendations to AI and product teams
Qualification

Required

• Recent graduate in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or a related field
• Strong SQL skills and familiarity with Python
• Understanding of statistics, experimentation, and data visualization
• Strong analytical and communication skills
• Ability to work effectively in a remote environment

Preferred

• Experience analyzing LLM, chatbot, or agent interactions
• Familiarity with product analytics or event-tracking systems
• Experience with pandas, Tableau, Looker, or similar tools
• Interest in AI evaluation, prompt engineering, or human-AI interaction

• Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills
• Understanding of funnels, cohorts, and experimentation

Preferred

• Interest in consumer growth and marketplace products
